caption: The drawing features a long, double-breasted coat in a solid light brown color, rendered with pencil and watercolor. The coat has a high, pointed collar and a row of six dark buttons running down the front, three on each side, with matching buttons on the large, flap-closure pocket positioned on the right hip. Both cuffs have decorative double-buttoned bands with geometrical detailing. The coat is shown with long sleeves, and its base flares slightly outward. There is visible stitching and seam detailing to indicate structure. In the upper right corner of the page, there is a smaller line drawing of the back view of the coat, showing added seam lines, a partial belt detail at the back, and a continuation of the sleeve trim. The background is an unadorned, slightly yellowed paper, giving focus to the coat designs.
title: Coat
